name: @jaggerxtrm/substrate
description: Durable work substrate: issue graph over SQLite/WAL (library-first; sb CLI consumes this). Published copies ship prebuilt JavaScript and run on Node >=24 or Bun >=1.3; from a source checkout the entry points are TypeScript and run directly, with no build step.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('release: publishing this directory would ship a TypeScript manifest that crashes under Node. Run: npm run release (it packs, verifies and publishes the JavaScript artifact).'); process.exit(1)"
